synthesizer.response: Since you haven’t logged a gym session recently, it’s safest to treat today as a light‑recovery day. Start with 10–15 minutes of low‑impact cardio (brisk walk, easy bike) to get blood flowing, then do a full‑body mobility routine (dynamic stretches for hips, shoulders, and spine). Finish with a short body‑weight circuit—2–3 sets of 10–15 reps of squats, push‑ups, and planks—to re‑activate muscles without heavy loading. This approach eases you back in while minimizing injury risk, especially if your last workout was more than a week ago.
